definitions.gloss: classification; type; category; sorting by kind
definitions.explanation: The act of classifying items by type, or the resulting categories. Commonly used in administrative, technical, and organizational contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦ごみ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{種別|しゅべつ}ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧。
⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{種別|しゅべつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please confirm the type of your license.

examples.japanese: ⟦{申請|しんせい}→申請：04207_shinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{種別|しゅべつ}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧な⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{異|こと}なります→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: The required documents differ depending on the type of application.

notes:
USAGE:
{種別|しゅべつ} is used in formal and administrative contexts for classifying things into categories. It often appears on forms and in official documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {種別|しゅべつ}ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (by type, per category)
- ⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧{種別|しゅべつ} (vehicle type/classification)
- {種別|しゅべつ}⟦コード→コード：00241_koodo⟧ (classification code)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧ is more general and means "kind" or "type" in everyday speech. ⟦{分類|ぶんるい}→分類：04790_bunrui⟧ emphasizes the act of categorizing, while {種別|しゅべつ} focuses on the categories themselves.
